title: Snapshot the fresh current-head workflow evidence and verify its gate before either reviewer

handoff.objective: Snapshot the fresh current-head workflow evidence and verify its gate before either reviewer
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Durable custody and exact current-head receipt/run binding before semantic review.
constraints: Zero formal builds/runs, workflow dispatches or scientific trials within this archive task.
Run alone after the verification operation; verify all captures and complete maps against its pinned published SHA, exact run ID/attempt and actual workflow step outcomes.
Archive all six sidecars, preserve failures and native artifact content bindings. Only a successful exact full formal gate and verified snapshot may open current-head-gate.json.
On any failure, archive actual failure evidence when possible but keep current-head-gate.json allows_reviewers=false; task terminal status alone cannot bypass the gate.
Commit/push/publication are future driving-session operations, not performed by authoring this card. No source/proof/EV/DEC/H changes or scientific promotion.
completion_gate: Source task captures exact immutable current-head receipt and real workflow evidence; every required correctness/custody check passes, or record allows_reviewers=false.
Snapshot actual commit/parent/exact changed paths/SHA-256s verified, pushed and reviewable before either reviewer starts.
current-head-gate.json binds pinned source SHA, workflow run/attempt, receipt hash, complete map check and actual snapshot publication; allows_reviewers=true only when every gate is met.
No official scientific conclusion or status change.

This success-gating archive must not be marked completed unless current-head-gate.json has allows_reviewers=true and its exact source/run/custody checks pass; failed-capture archival needs an explicit additive route and never enables reviewers.
handoff.return_format: Verified archive/gate paths and actual custody/provenance, or exact fail-closed impediment.
